issues.reason: Thematic roles decides by one test — 'does the object itself change?' — and depositing threads on a lantern displaces them unaltered ('displacement stays displacement whatever is moved'), which is the Theme branch the same parse already uses for 'collected the silken threads'; even on an unclear reading the stated default is Theme, so (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_threads_1) asserts a change to the threads the text does not state.
The per-member rule reproduces the identical mis-assignment inside its conclusion, (Patient (sk_leave $x) sk_threads_1), so every derived member event carries the same unstated change claim.

The licensing half stands — a participle used as a modifier is an adjective ('a laminated worktop' -> (Member sk_worktop_1 laminated)), so (Member sk_mire_essence_2 stored) is available and the parse records the participle nowhere as a property — but the defect half does not: 'stored' here is anaphoric, its referent resolves correctly to sk_mire_essence_2, and the storing is already asserted at top level by s13_ev/s13_th on that very symbol, so the omission emits nothing false and drops no stated content.

gaps_confirmed: An enumerative ordinal on an object ('the third cauldron') with no associated event and no stated '-est' dimension: Ordinal's scale slot has no licensed filler, and the parse improvises with the entity's own class (cauldron) — acceptable improvisation here, since the atom is true and well-formed, but the slot is genuinely uncovered.

A day-of-year date ('day 100 / 101 of Year 1', no month): (Day n) is the day-of-month slot and the seeded date-ordering rules key on year/month/day, so the two dated days are recorded but not orderable as written.

A locative stacked on a bare-mass oblique object ('boiled ... in sea-water in the third cauldron'): the stacking rule is written for a second 'in <Place>' on a place NP, and the oblique-object rule keeps a bare mass as a constant that LocatedIn's entity slot may not take, so the sea-water-inside-the-cauldron nesting has no licensed carrier and both PPs flatten onto the event as coordinate Location atoms.
new_gaps: The causative/inchoative alternation across sentences ('The lantern burned mire-essence.' ... 'The mire-essence burned slowly.') has no licensed identity link — coreference covers entities and pronominal event anaphora only — so the two clauses mint sk_burn_1 and sk_burn_2 and the Manner adverb lands on an event with no stated connection to the lantern that was doing the burning.
defect_summary: Statement 50's compliant form is (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_threads_1) — the threads are placed, not created, destroyed or altered — and statement 53's rule conclusion takes the same swap, (Theme (sk_leave $x) sk_threads_1), with everything else in both bundles unchanged.
notes: Apart from the leave-role, the passage is handled closely to the instruction set: name-internal kind typing for Harbor Station / Cauldron Hall, silken_thread's material-adjective modifier genus against clay_vessel's suppressed noun modifier, (TimeAtMost sk_form_1 evening) for 'by evening', Location-on-the-event-only for the forming and the storing, and group event plus per-member rule for the distributive moth predicates. The split treatment of bare mass objects (a witness for mire-essence, a bare kind constant for salt-bloom) is licensed either way and is motivated here by which one takes later definite anaphora.
